verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and they share the same flaws. The 'JULY 29' date is shrunk into a small side label next to the huge headline, so it loses its role as a clear tier above it. The red divider is left on its own at the far left. The sewing illustration is pushed left, leaving a large empty area on the right. B narrows A's top margin and moves the illustration up, so its gap to the 'FOR BEGINNERS / GROVE.ONLINE' footer is less cramped than in A, but the difference is small.
